learning_outcomes.text: Students can select suitable molecular materials for special applications or evaluate suitable modification options for materials for their intended use. For this, they have a deeper understanding of the different ways to influence material behavior through chemical or physical changes or by adding other substances, depending on the application.
Students can analyze aging processes and propose/evaluate measures to prevent or delay them.
Students understand the differences between so-called biopolymers, biological composite materials, and petrochemical-based polymers.

syllabus_topics: Chemical structure and physical arrangement of macromolecules
Aging processes and stabilization possibilities for polymer materials
Modification of specific material properties through fillers and reinforcing materials or nanoparticles, Antistatic equipment
Creation of specific surface properties, such as self-cleaning, scratch resistance, metallic luster, wettability, etc.
Technical biopolymers, history, biodegradability, legal framework conditions, tests, production and chemical structure, technical properties, End of Life Options, material manufacturers and types
Special cases of polymer materials and their use
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded for passing the module examination. The grading's relevance for the final grade is in accordance with the study and examination regulations (SPO).
